evidence.excerpt: Today we’re launching @tryinstance — an AI data analyst for your team. Instead of waiting on someone who knows SQL (or pasting sensitive data into ChatGPT), you can just ask stuff like: “Which features do paid customers use most?” and get real answers straight from your database in seconds. @LucyCai9 and I have been building this with a month-long @ycombinator program at MIT and we’re now running early demos with startups + data-driven teams. If questions about internal data slow your team…
